2. sCope of Work exeCuted
Irrigation works for Peninsular Petroleum Corporation completed 2021.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included existing services running across
the corridor that had to be protected in place. The agency organised its resources around this
without recourse to the department for additional assistance, and the programme was re-
sequenced locally to keep the critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of a revision to the approved
drawings issued after mobilisation. The delay was examined by this office and held to be beyond
the agency's control; no compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
DOC-CC-069
Page 1 of 3

The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the
approved drawings, specifications, and the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has
been completed in all respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief /
Superintending Engineer.
3. Quality assessment
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Satisfactory. Workmanship was acceptable
with minor rework at two locations, and the work was inspected in stages, with each stage
recorded in the measurement book. Materials were drawn from approved sources and the test
results filed with this office were within the limits prescribed in the contract specification.

5. defiCienCy / observation list
At the time of taking over, two hand-railing sections replaced during the defect liability period.
Regarding site safety, no lost-time injury was reported over the contract period. The agency's
conduct during the contract is recorded as prompt and well documented.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2021-01-26. All
minor observations pointed out during the interim inspections have been rectified to the
satisfaction of the inspecting authority.
DOC-CC-069
Page 2 of 3

6. reCommendation
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of
the joint measurements recorded in the measurement book, I certify the work complete and
recommend release of the balance payment together with the retention money due on expiry of
the defect liability period. Certified by M. Venkatesh, Project Director.
The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and
contract conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection
carried out by the undersigned.
This certificate is issued for the sole purpose of recording completion of the above work and does not absolve the
contractor of any obligations under the contract, including the defect liability period.
